parts.text: Plan a team lunch for next week that aligns with our corporate strategy.
A lunch proposal naming a strategic objective, listing every attendee, offering time slots and a catering menu.
Plan a team lunch. Maya is allergic to dairy, Jordan is vegan, and Kai is gluten-free. Everyone must be able to eat.

Every menu item must be safe for a dairy allergy, vegan and gluten-free diner, or the menu must clearly cover each restriction with at least one suitable dish. No dish may contain dairy, meat or gluten without that being called out.
Set up a lunch for the team next Tuesday. I don't think we've recorded anyone's dietary needs yet.
A proposal that still renders correctly with no stored preferences, choosing a broadly inclusive menu rather than inventing restrictions.
Book a team lunch this week. Liam is out Monday and Tuesday, Maya is out Wednesday and Thursday, and Diego is only free Friday morning. Pick the best option.
No slot suits everyone, so the proposal should still offer concrete slots, recommend one, and be honest about who cannot attend rather than claiming full availability.
The only time the team is free is Friday 12:00-13:00. Set the lunch up for then.
A proposal with exactly one time slot offered and recommended; the picker must still render correctly with a single option.
Aaliyah has a severe nut allergy - please remember that. Then plan a team lunch for next week.
The nut allergy is saved to memory and the proposed catering menu is nut-free, with the restriction surfaced against the relevant items.
Plan a team lunch for next week aligned with the OmniChef launch.
I've proposed an OmniChef alignment lunch, recommending Tuesday at 12:00.
Tuesday doesn't work for me. Can we do Wednesday instead?
A re-rendered proposal recommending Wednesday, still offering the other slots, and preserving the strategic framing and menu.
